sources.fact: LBBD59/CW 90 Stour Road is 0.26ha, 150 net dwellings, ownership-status owned-by-a-public-authority and planning-permission-status not-permissioned.
LBBD Regulation 19 agenda materials list CW - 90 Stour Road as a site-allocation document, confirming policy provenance rather than planning permission.
The Local Plan Regulation 19 decision carries CW as a distinct allocation attachment; allocation reference is not an application reference.
In January 2015 Cabinet approved disposal of 90 Stour Road for the best consideration and terms reasonably achievable.
The 2015 disposal decision confirms a Council freehold-disposal action, but does not prove present proprietor, completed conveyance, planning permission or exact current title geometry.
LBBD Local Plan 2037 is adopted policy context; site allocation does not itself grant consent.
Development-plan status guides decisions but does not prove delivery or ownership.
Brownfield Register sites require planning permission before development.
Current planning status requires exact application/decision evidence; no exact current CW application was verified this wave.
Planning Data point/discovery data is not converted to an exact red-line or title relation.
The national Brownfield dataset is authoritative-source register evidence and is kept separate from application/land-title evidence.
Council land/property information is contextual and is not substituted for a fresh HMLR proprietor/title check.

examples.result: CW remains not-permissioned at 150 net dwellings.
150 is allocation/Brownfield capacity, not consented units.
2015 disposal approval is not treated as a planning permission.
2015 disposal approval is not treated as proof of present owner or completed conveyance.
Public-authority ownership category is not converted to a named legal proprietor.
Allocation attachment/reference is not converted to an application reference.
No current CW planning case is guessed from the site name/address.
Promotion remains zero until exact current application, HMLR title/site relation and overlays are verified.
